input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: The Agreement meets our preferred position: Section 2.1 expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment and confirms Customer pays only for Services ordered under a signed Order Form, with no shortfall exposure for declining further orders. Section 7.1 bars any undisclosed minimum-use or similar charge, and Section 12.3 confirms Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment. No take-or-pay, committed spend, shortfall penalty, or volume cap on Customer usage appears anywhere (the Section 22 "shortfall" references concern Vendor underpayment/usage audit true-ups, not a Customer commitment). Section 9.4 also gives Customer a without-cause exit with refund of prepaid Fees, so any future Order Form commitment would have an exit. No redline required.
